# Will Ethereum Hit USD 4,000 Before the End of 2026?
Ethereum would need a substantial rally to reach USD 4,000 by the end of 2026. With ETH trading around USD 2,700 in late September, reaching that threshold would require an increase of approximately 48%, making institutional demand, network development and macroeconomic conditions important variables.
## Ethereum Remains Below USD 3,000
==Ethereum== trades at USD 2,658, with a decline of 1.48% in the last 24 hours on September 30 amid volatility across cryptocurrency and global markets. Ethereum has a market capitalization of approximately USD 324.48 billion and a 24-hour trading volume of around USD 14.65 billion.
From USD 2,700, ETH would need to gain roughly USD 1,300, or about 48%, to reach USD 4,000. Such a move would require substantially stronger demand during the remaining months of 2026.
## ETF Flows Provide Institutional Demand
US spot Ethereum ETFs have recently recorded renewed inflows. According to ==SoSoValue==, on September 28, the total net inflow into spot Ethereum ETFs is USD 17.0959 million. The spot Ethereum ETF with the highest single-day net inflow is BlackRock’s ETHA, with a single-day net inflow of USD 15.3539 million; ETHA’s cumulative net inflow to date stands at USD 13.299 billion. Second is 21Shares’ TETH, with a single-day net inflow of USD 1.742 million; TETH’s cumulative net inflow to date is USD 32.8813 million. The week ending on September 25 recorded USD 689.88 million in net inflows.
Sustained ETF inflows can create additional spot-market demand for ETH. However, flows remain volatile: September also included daily outflows of USD 224.1 million on September 16 and USD 142 million on September 15.
